title: Learning and Forgetting Unsafe Examples in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype detection and bias measurement related to religious groups (e.g., Arabs/Muslims, Jews) using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) dataset.
findings: Models readily learn religious and other stereotypes from finetuning data. However, these unsafe, biased examples are forgotten more significantly and rapidly than safe or task-related examples during subsequent safety finetuning. This selective forgetting phenomenon is more pronounced in larger models like LLaMA-7B compared to smaller ones like GPT-2-M.
